title: Google Ads Transparency Scraper Input

searchQuery.title: Advertiser Domain or Name
searchQuery.description: Use this field when the user provides a company domain (e.g. 'nike.com') or brand name (e.g. 'Nike'). Do NOT use this when passing a direct Ads Transparency URL — use startUrls instead. This is the primary way to find all ads a specific advertiser is running on Google.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Define which advertiser's ads to extract

searchType.title: Search By
searchType.description: Use 'domain' when searchQuery is a website domain like 'example.com'. Use 'advertiserName' when searchQuery is a brand name like 'Nike'. Domain search is more precise; name search is broader.

countryCode.title: Country / Region
countryCode.description: Filter ads shown in this country. Uses ISO 2-letter country codes. Default is 'US'. Use 'ANY' to see ads from all regions.

adFormat.title: Ad Format Filter
adFormat.description: Filter by ad creative format. 'ALL' returns every format. 'TEXT' returns text-only search ads. 'IMAGE' returns display/banner ads. 'VIDEO' returns YouTube video ads.

maxResults.title: Max Ads to Scrape
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to extract per run. Each ad is one billable event at $0.003. Set to 50 for a quick competitive snapshot. Set to 200+ for comprehensive analysis.

startUrls.title: Direct Advertiser URLs (Optional)
startUrls.description: Use this field instead of searchQuery when you have specific Google Ads Transparency Center URLs for known advertisers (e.g. https://adstransparency.google.com/advertiser/AR12345). Leave empty to use the searchQuery field instead.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Optional: directly target specific advertisers by URL

enrichDetails.title: Enrich with detail-page fields
enrichDetails.description: When true, visits each ad's creative detail page after listing extraction to populate first_shown_date, last_shown_date, regions_shown, platforms, ad_headline, and ad_text. Set to false for fastest listing-only mode (these fields will be null/empty).

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
